cases.prompt: Measure why the launcher is slow and provide before-and-after profile evidence for a fix.
cases.rationale: Measured launcher performance work is the skill's purpose.

cases.prompt: Profile an App Run callback and identify the owning measured bottleneck.
cases.rationale: Callback profiling with an owner-aligned scenario is in scope.

cases.prompt: Review this callback for correctness without making a performance claim.
cases.rationale: Ordinary correctness review does not require profiling.

cases.prompt: Remove a loop because it looks slow from inspection alone.
cases.rationale: A suspected performance problem belongs to measurement; activation does not endorse an unmeasured optimization.

cases.prompt: Read this existing profile report and explain the bottleneck without changing code.
cases.rationale: A report review does not imply a new profile or implementation.
